title: Pod Salt Core Blue Berg Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blue Berg by Pod Salts is a mouth-watering combination of mixed fruits, including berries and notes of citrus, with a streak of ice cool Menthol for a deliciously soothing and satisfying draw. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
